svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outer arm: 380 mm of 20 x 1.2 tube; 8 mm cross hole 10 mm from one

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end (pivot); 6.5 mm pin holes every 50 mm along the last 250 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inner arm: 360 mm of 16 x 1.2 tube; 6.5 mm hole near one end; slides

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in the outer arm for 200 to 900 mm reach; one pin sets it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Disc: cut a 140 mm disc from 2 mm plate, 16.5 mm centre hole; bolt it

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to a hub of 28 mm bar 28 long, bored 16 mm, which takes the inner

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arm's end and turns on an M8 bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the reach so the disc runs at the next row's centre (750 mm for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: maize), measured from the row being sown.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: disc runs true; the marked line is within 25 mm of the set row.
